ostrzezenia.tekst: Raw (unpasteurized) milk can carry dangerous germs such as Salmonella, E. coli, Listeria and Campylobacter.
The FDA says these germs are especially dangerous to people with weakened immune systems, children, older adults and pregnant women.
Listeria is often found in raw milk, and in pregnant women it can cause miscarriage, or illness or death of the newborn baby.
The FDA lists unpasteurized milk or cream, cheeses made from unpasteurized milk and yogurt made from unpasteurized milk as high-risk choices.
Raw milk does not kill dangerous pathogens by itself.
